breakdown: 民(people)+族(clan) — a people and their clan

examples.cn: 每个民族都有自己的文化。
examples.py: Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ de wénhuà.
examples.en: Every ethnic group has its own culture.
Ethnic groups should respect each other.

breakdown: 母(mother)+亲(relative, close) — your close mother

examples.py: Mǔqīn duì háizi de ài zuì shēn.
examples.en: A mother's love for her child is deepest.

examples.py: Wǒ hěn gǎnxiè wǒ de mǔqīn.
examples.en: I'm very grateful to my mother.

examples.py: Tā zhǎng de hěn xiàng mǔqīn.
examples.en: She looks a lot like her mother.

breakdown: 目(eye)+的(target) — what your eye is aimed at

examples.cn: 这次旅行的目的是学习。
examples.py: Zhè cì lǚxíng de mùdì shì xuéxí.
examples.en: The purpose of this trip is learning.
Without a goal there's no direction.

examples.py: Tā dádào le zìjǐ de mùdì.

khmer: ការអត់ធ្មត់
breakdown: 耐(endure)+心(heart) — a heart that endures

examples.en: Please be a bit more patient.

examples.py: Wǒ méiyǒu nàixīn děng xiàqù le.
examples.en: I have no patience to keep waiting.

english: could it be that...?; don't tell me
breakdown: 难(hard)+道(say) — 'is it hard to say that...?', used for rhetorical questions

examples.en: Don't tell me you don't know?
Could it be that he forgot?

examples.py: Nándào zhèyàng zuò bú duì ma?
examples.en: Is doing it this way really wrong?

examples.py: Nándào nǐ bù xiǎng chénggōng ma?

examples.en: Did I really say something wrong?

english: to feel unwell; to feel bad
khmer: មិនស្រួលខ្លួន
breakdown: 难(hard)+受(bear) — hard to bear

examples.cn: 听到这个消息我很难受。
examples.py: Tīng dào zhège xiāoxi wǒ hěn nánshòu.
examples.en: I felt bad hearing this news.
It's so hot I feel uncomfortable.

breakdown: 冂(enclosure)+入(enter) — entering inside

examples.py: Qǐng zài sān tiān nèi wánchéng.

examples.cn: 一个月内他改变了很多。
examples.py: Yí ge yuè nèi tā gǎibiàn le hěn duō.
examples.en: He changed a lot within a month.

examples.cn: 这个价格在我的预算内。
examples.py: Zhège jiàgé zài wǒ de yùsuàn nèi.
examples.en: This price is within my budget.

examples.cn: 国内和国外都有分公司。
examples.py: Guónèi hé guówài dōu yǒu fēn gōngsī.
examples.en: There are branches both at home and abroad.

breakdown: 内(inside)+容(contain) — what is contained inside

examples.cn: 这本书的内容很有意思。
examples.py: Zhè běn shū de nèiróng hěn yǒu yìsi.

examples.en: This part of the content is important.

examples.py: Wǒ wàng le huìyì de nèiróng.

breakdown: 能(able)+力(power) — the power to be able

examples.py: Zhè chāoguò le wǒ de nénglì.

examples.cn: 工作能力比学历更重要。
examples.py: Gōngzuò nénglì bǐ xuélì gèng zhòngyào.
examples.en: Work ability matters more than degrees.

examples.py: Méiyǒu rén huáiyí tā de nénglì.

breakdown: 年(year)+龄(age, 齿tooth radical) — old age was told by teeth

examples.en: We are about the same age.

examples.cn: 这个活动没有年龄限制。
examples.en: This event has no age limit.

breakdown: 暖(warm, 日sun radical)+和(gentle) — gently warm like the sun
偶(by chance, 亻person radical)+尔(so) — happening by chance

examples.en: I occasionally go to the cinema.
We contact each other once in a while.
Resting once in a while is important.

breakdown: 排(arrange in a row)+队(team, line) — arranging into a line

examples.py: Zhèlǐ páiduì de rén hěn duō.
Wǒ pái le bàn ge xiǎoshí de duì.
examples.en: I queued for half an hour.
Queuing is a form of politeness.
You must queue to buy tickets.

english: to arrange; to line up in order
khmer: រៀបតាមលំដាប់
breakdown: 排(arrange)+列(line, row) — putting into rows

examples.en: The books are arranged by name.

examples.cn: 这些数字排列得很整齐。
examples.py: Zhèxiē shùzì páiliè de hěn zhěngqí.

examples.en: The chairs are arranged in two rows.

breakdown: 判(judge, 刂knife radical)+断(cut off) — cutting a clear decision

examples.py: Wǒ bù néng pànduàn shéi duì.
examples.en: I can't judge who is right.
Please judge based on the materials.

examples.cn: 判断错了就要重新考虑。
examples.py: Pànduàn cuò le jiù yào chóngxīn kǎolǜ.
examples.en: If the judgment is wrong, reconsider.

examples.cn: 从声音可以判断他很累。
examples.py: Cóng shēngyīn kěyǐ pànduàn tā hěn lèi.
examples.en: From his voice you can tell he's tired.

breakdown: 阝(mound radical)+咅 — staying alongside someone

examples.en: He accompanied his mother to the hospital.
Thank you for keeping me company.
On weekends I play with my child.

examples.py: Qǐng péi wǒ qù guàngjiē ba.

breakdown: 批(comment on, 扌hand radical)+评(judge, 讠speech radical) — commenting and judging

examples.en: Encouragement is more useful than criticism.

examples.py: Yīnwèi mǎhu, tā bèi pīpíng le.
examples.en: He was criticized for being careless.

breakdown: 皮(skin, hide)+肤(skin, 月body radical) — two skin characters together

examples.en: The sun is bad for the skin.
Skin gets dry easily in winter.
His skin is a bit red.

examples.py: Duō hē shuǐ duì pífū yǒu hǎochu.

khmer: អារម្មណ៍ / និស្ស័យ
breakdown: 脾(spleen, 月body radical)+气(energy) — old belief that temper came from the spleen

examples.py: Tā píqi bù hǎo, róngyì shēngqì.
examples.en: She has a bad temper and gets angry easily.

examples.py: Lèi de shíhou píqi huì biàn chà.
examples.en: When tired your temper gets worse.

khmer: ច្បាប់ (សម្រាប់អត្ថបទ)
breakdown: 竹(bamboo radical)+扁 — writing was on bamboo strips

examples.py: Wǒ dú le yì piān wénzhāng.
Tā xiě le sān piān rìjì.

breakdown: 马(horse radical)+扁 — tricking someone onto a horse

examples.py: Tā piàn le hěn duō rén.

examples.cn: 网上有很多骗人的广告。
examples.py: Wǎng shàng yǒu hěn duō piàn rén de guǎnggào.
examples.en: There are many deceptive ads online.

examples.py: Piàn rén shì bù chéngshí de.

khmer: បាល់ប៉ីងប៉ុង
breakdown: 乒乓(the sound of the ball)+球(ball) — named for its sound

examples.py: Tā de pīngpāngqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo.
examples.en: He plays table tennis very well.
Let's play table tennis this afternoon.
The table tennis match was brilliant.

breakdown: 平(ordinary, level)+时(time) — ordinary times

examples.en: I usually get up at six.
You should practice more in normal times.
Usually there aren't many people here.

breakdown: 石(stone radical)+皮(skin) — a stone breaking a surface

examples.py: Xiǎoxīn bié bǎ pánzi dǎ pò.
examples.en: Be careful not to break the plate.

examples.py: Tā de xié pò le ge dòng.
examples.en: His shoe has a hole in it.

examples.py: Pò le de dōngxi hái néng xiūlǐ.
examples.en: Broken things can still be repaired.

khmer: ទំពាំងបាយជូរ
breakdown: 葡+萄, both with 艹(grass radical) — a two-character plant name

examples.py: Wǒ mǎi le yì gōngjīn pútao.
examples.en: I bought a kilogram of grapes.

examples.py: Pútaojiǔ shì yòng pútao zuò de.
Pútao zài bīngxiāng lǐ hěn xīnxiān.
examples.en: The grapes stay fresh in the fridge.

breakdown: 普(general)+遍(everywhere) — general and everywhere

examples.py: Zhè shì yí ge pǔbiàn de kànfǎ.

examples.cn: 普遍来说，年轻人喜欢上网。
examples.py: Pǔbiàn lái shuō, niánqīng rén xǐhuan shàngwǎng.
examples.en: Generally, young people like going online.

examples.cn: 这种情况在城市里很普遍。
examples.py: Zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng zài chéngshì lǐ hěn pǔbiàn.
examples.en: This situation is common in cities.

khmer: ភាសាចិនកុកងឺ
breakdown: 普通(common)+话(speech) — the common speech

examples.py: Wǒ de pǔtōnghuà bú tài biāozhǔn.

breakdown: 其(that)+次(order, time) — the next in order

examples.cn: 首先是安全，其次是速度。
examples.py: Shǒuxiān shì ānquán, qícì shì sùdù.
examples.en: First is safety, second is speed.

examples.cn: 内容最重要，其次是形式。
examples.py: Nèiróng zuì zhòngyào, qícì shì xíngshì.
Qícì de wèntí yǐhòu zài shuō.

examples.cn: 首先要有目的，其次要有计划。
examples.py: Shǒuxiān yào yǒu mùdì, qícì yào yǒu jìhuà.
examples.en: First have a goal, then have a plan.

khmer: ក្នុងចំណោមនោះ
breakdown: 其(that)+中(middle) — in the middle of that group

examples.py: Qízhōng yí ge shì wǒ de.

examples.cn: 有十个人，其中三个是学生。
examples.py: Yǒu shí ge rén, qízhōng sān ge shì xuésheng.
examples.en: There are ten people, three of them students.
The reasons behind it are complex.

examples.cn: 这些书其中一本很有名。
examples.py: Zhèxiē shū qízhōng yì běn hěn yǒumíng.
examples.en: One of these books is famous.

examples.cn: 我参加了很多活动，其中这个最好。
examples.py: Wǒ cānjiā le hěn duō huódòng, qízhōng zhège zuì hǎo.
examples.en: I joined many events, this one was the best.

breakdown: 气(air, weather)+候(season, condition) — long-term weather conditions

examples.py: Qìhòu biànhuà shì ge dà wèntí.
examples.en: Climate change is a big problem.

examples.py: Wǒ bù xíguàn zhèlǐ de qìhòu.
examples.en: I'm not used to the climate here.

khmer: ត្រូវតែ (ការព្រមាន)
breakdown: 千(thousand)+万(ten thousand) — a huge amount, used to stress urgency

examples.en: By all means don't be late.

examples.cn: 这件事千万别告诉别人。
examples.py: Zhè jiàn shì qiānwàn bié gàosu biéren.

examples.en: Be sure to remember your passport.

breakdown: 签(sign)+证(certificate) — a signed certificate

examples.en: I need to get a visa.
Visas are handled at the embassy.

examples.py: Wǒ de qiānzhèng xià ge yuè dàoqī.
Bàn qiānzhèng yào hěn duō cáiliào.
examples.en: Getting a visa requires many documents.

examples.py: Méiyǒu qiānzhèng bù néng chū guó.
examples.en: Without a visa you can't go abroad.

breakdown: 高(tall)+攴(strike) — striking something

examples.en: Someone is knocking at the door.

examples.py: Tā qīngqīng de qiāo le qiāo zhuōzi.
examples.en: He lightly knocked on the table.

examples.py: Wǒ qiāo le hěn jiǔ, méi rén kāi mén.
examples.en: I knocked a long time, nobody opened.

examples.py: Qiāo mén shì yì zhǒng lǐmào.
examples.en: Knocking is a form of politeness.

breakdown: 木(wood radical)+乔(tall) — a tall wooden structure

examples.py: Qiáo shàng de jǐngsè hěn měi.
examples.en: The view from the bridge is beautiful.

examples.py: Zhè zuò qiáo yǒu yìbǎi nián le.
examples.en: This bridge is a hundred years old.

examples.py: Guò le qiáo jiù dào le.
examples.en: Cross the bridge and you're there.

breakdown: A sound-borrowed word from English 'chocolate'

examples.py: Tā sòng le wǒ yì hé qiǎokèlì.
examples.en: He gave me a box of chocolate.

examples.py: Qiǎokèlì chī duō le bù hǎo.
examples.en: Eating too much chocolate isn't good.

breakdown: 亲(close, kin)+戚(relative) — close kin

examples.cn: 过节的时候亲戚都来了。
examples.py: Guò jié de shíhou qīnqi dōu lái le.
examples.en: All the relatives came during the festival.

examples.py: Wǒ yǒu hěn duō qīnqi zài guówài.

breakdown: 车(vehicle radical)+圣 — a light cart

examples.py: Tā qīngqīng de guān shàng le mén.

examples.cn: 轻的东西容易被风吹走。
examples.py: Qīng de dōngxi róngyì bèi fēng chuī zǒu.

breakdown: 轻(light)+松(loose) — light and loose

examples.py: Kǎo wán shì wǒ hěn qīngsōng.
examples.en: After the exam I felt relaxed.

examples.py: Tā qīngsōng de wánchéng le rènwu.

breakdown: 情(condition, feeling)+况(situation) — the state of things

examples.py: Zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng hěn shǎo jiàn.
Qíngkuàng bǐ wǒ xiǎng de fùzá.
examples.en: The situation is more complex than I thought.
We'll decide based on the situation.

breakdown: 穴(cave)+力(strength) — living in a cave, out of strength

examples.en: He was poor as a child.
Being poor doesn't mean being unhappy.
This country used to be poor.

khmer: ភាពខុសគ្នា
breakdown: 区(divide, area)+别(separate) — dividing and separating

examples.py: Zhè liǎng ge yǒu shénme qūbié?
examples.en: What's the difference between these two?

examples.cn: 这两个词的区别很重要。
examples.py: Zhè liǎng ge cí de qūbié hěn zhòngyào.
examples.en: The difference between these two words matters.

english: to take; to fetch; to withdraw
breakdown: 耳(ear)+又(hand) — a hand taking hold

examples.en: I'm going to the bank to withdraw money.
He goes to the post office to collect a package.
You need your PIN to withdraw money.

breakdown: 全(whole)+部(part) — every part of the whole

examples.py: Zhè bú shì quánbù de yuányīn.

khmer: ចំណុចខ្សោយ
breakdown: 缺(lacking)+点(point) — a point that is lacking

examples.py: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu quēdiǎn.

examples.cn: 这个方法的缺点是太慢。
examples.py: Zhège fāngfǎ de quēdiǎn shì tài màn.
examples.en: This method's weakness is being too slow.
There are more strengths than weaknesses.

english: to lack; to be short of
breakdown: 缺(lacking)+少(few) — lacking and few
Whole shape — a turning word placed before the verb

examples.py: Tā hěn niánqīng, jīngyàn què hěn duō.
examples.en: He is young, yet has much experience.

examples.py: Wǒ jiào le tā, tā què méi tīngjiàn.
examples.en: I called him, yet he didn't hear.

examples.py: Dōngxi hěn guì, zhìliàng què bù hǎo.
examples.en: It's expensive, yet the quality is poor.

examples.cn: 他学得很久，却还不流利。
examples.py: Tā xué de hěn jiǔ, què hái bù liúlì.
examples.en: He studied long, yet still isn't fluent.

examples.cn: 天气不好，我们却很开心。
examples.py: Tiānqì bù hǎo, wǒmen què hěn kāixīn.
examples.en: The weather was bad, yet we were happy.

breakdown: 确(certain)+实(real) — certainly real

examples.py: Zhè quèshí shì ge hǎo bànfǎ.
examples.en: This is indeed a good method.

examples.py: Zhège xiāoxi quèshí shì zhēn de.

khmer: ទោះជាយ៉ាងណា
breakdown: 然(so)+而(but) — 'so, but' — a formal turn

examples.cn: 他很努力，然而没有成功。
examples.py: Tā hěn nǔlì, rán'ér méiyǒu chénggōng.
examples.en: He tried hard, however he didn't succeed.

examples.cn: 计划很好，然而很难实现。
examples.py: Jìhuà hěn hǎo, rán'ér hěn nán shíxiàn.
examples.en: The plan is good, however it's hard to realize.

examples.cn: 我同意，然而有一个条件。
examples.py: Wǒ tóngyì, rán'ér yǒu yí ge tiáojiàn.
examples.en: I agree, however there is one condition.

examples.cn: 价格很低，然而质量不好。
examples.py: Jiàgé hěn dī, rán'ér zhìliàng bù hǎo.
examples.en: The price is low, however the quality is poor.

khmer: មមាញឹករំភើប
breakdown: 热(hot)+闹(noisy) — hot and noisy with people

examples.en: The streets are lively during festivals.
The night market is especially lively.

khmer: ណាមួយក៏បាន
breakdown: 任(allow, any)+何(what) — any whatever

examples.en: I have no questions at all.

examples.cn: 任何时候都可以联系我。
examples.py: Rènhé shíhou dōu kěyǐ liánxì wǒ.
examples.en: You can contact me any time.

examples.cn: 这件事跟他没有任何关系。
examples.py: Zhè jiàn shì gēn tā méiyǒu rènhé guānxi.
examples.en: This has nothing to do with him.

examples.cn: 任何困难都不能让我放弃。
examples.py: Rènhé kùnnan dōu bù néng ràng wǒ fàngqì.
examples.en: No difficulty can make me give up.
